q: Didn't you order the paper?
ex: 否定問句 Didn't you 是在確認「你訂了吧？」。回答方式和一般問句一樣：有訂就說 Yes。Yes, it will arrive tomorrow 回答有訂，明天到。In the newspaper 的 newspaper 是「報紙」；The waiter took our order 的 order 是餐廳「點餐」，都答非所問。

q: Do you offer free delivery?
answer: Yes, for orders over fifty dollars.
zh_answer: 有，訂單超過五十美元就可以。
ex: 問有沒有免費送貨，Yes, for orders over fifty dollars 回答有，並說明條件。It arrived this morning 說的是東西何時送到；I'm free on Friday 的 free 是「有空」，不是「免費」。

q: Is your flight on Monday or Tuesday?
zh_q: 你的班機是星期一還是星期二？
ex: 選擇問句問星期一或星期二，It's on Tuesday 選了星期二。At the airport 回答的是地點；Yes, it is 沒有說是哪一天，選擇問句不能只用 Yes 回答。

q: Can you give me a ride to the station?
distractors: Yes, I gave it to him.
ex: Can you give me a ride 是請對方載一程，Sure, I'm leaving at five 答應並說出發時間。It's a radio station 的 station 是「電台」；Yes, I gave it to him 只是重複 give，答非所問。

q: How much is the admission fee?
ex: How much 問價錢，Ten dollars for adults 回答金額。At the front gate 回答的是地點；It opens at nine 回答的是時間。

q: Did you remind Tom about the meeting?
answer: Yes, I sent him a message.
zh_q: 你有提醒湯姆開會的事嗎？
ex: 問有沒有提醒湯姆，Yes, I sent him a message 回答有，傳了訊息。In the meeting room 回答的是地點；It was two hours long 回答的是會議多長。

q: Do you have a reservation?
ex: 問有沒有訂位，Yes, under the name Lee 回答有，並說出訂位姓名。Yes, it was delicious 雖然有 Yes，但說的是食物好吃，答非所問；At the bus stop 回答的是地點。

q: Could you help me move this equipment?
distractors: Yes, I moved here last year.
zh_q: 你可以幫我搬這些設備嗎？
ex: Could you 是請求幫忙，Sure, where does it go 先答應，再問要搬去哪裡。Yes, I moved here last year 的 move 是「搬家」，答非所問；It arrived yesterday 說的是到貨時間，沒有回應請求。

q: Would you like a refund?
answer: No, I'd like a different size.
ex: 問要不要退款，No, I'd like a different size 回答不要，想換尺寸。Yes, I like it here 只是重複 like，說的是喜歡這裡；At the entrance 回答的是地點。

q: What does this box contain?
ex: What 問箱子的內容物，Printer paper and pens 回答東西。It's on the shelf 回答的是位置；No, it's too heavy 用 No 回答 What 問句不合。

q: Would you mind opening the window?
answer: Not at all. It is hot in here.
zh_answer: 一點也不介意，這裡面很熱。
ex: Would you mind 是客氣的請求，Not at all 表示「不介意」，也就是答應。Yes, it opens at nine 說的是營業時間；By the window, please 是在選座位，都沒有回應請求。

q: How would you like to pay?
ex: How would you like to pay 問付款方式，By credit card 回答方式（信用卡）。Fifty dollars 回答的是金額；Yes, I'd like one 用 Yes 回答 How 問句不合。

q: Who gave you permission to leave early?
zh_q: 是誰准許你提早離開的？
ex: Who 問是誰准許的，My manager did 回答人（我的經理）。At four o'clock 回答的是時間；Yes, I left early 用 Yes 回答 Who 問句不合。

q: What's the fare to the airport?
ex: What's the fare 問車資，It's twenty dollars 回答金額。About forty minutes 回答的是車程時間；At terminal one 回答的是地點。

q: Who booked the hotel rooms?
ex: Who 問是誰訂的，Linda did it yesterday 回答人。For three nights 回答的是住幾晚；Near the airport 回答的是地點。

q: Why did Tom cancel his reservation?
ex: Why 問原因，He had to work late 說明原因（要加班）。A table for two 說的是訂位內容；At seven o'clock 回答的是時間。

q: The printer is out of paper.
answer: I'll get some from the supply room.
zh_answer: 我去用品儲藏室拿一些來。
ex: 對方說印表機沒紙，I'll get some from the supply room 表示要去拿紙，是合理的回應。Yes, I read the newspaper 的 newspaper 是「報紙」；On page ten 說的是頁數，都沒有回應這個狀況。

q: Who is the author of this article?
ex: Who 問作者是誰，Mr. Brown wrote it 回答人。It's about travel 說的是文章主題；In last month's magazine 回答的是刊在哪裡。

q: Will you attend the training tomorrow?
ex: 問明天會不會參加，Yes, I already signed up 回答會，而且已報名。Yes, it rained all day 雖然有 Yes，但說的是下雨，rain 只是和 training 發音相近；At the train station 回答的是地點，train 也只是和 training 發音相近。

q: Whose laptop is this?
zh_distractors: 對，我買了一台筆記型電腦。
ex: Whose 問東西是誰的，It's Kevin's 回答所有人。About one thousand dollars 回答的是價錢；Yes, I bought a laptop 用 Yes 回答 Whose 問句不合。

q: Why was the flight canceled?
ex: Why 問原因，Because of the bad weather 回答原因。At gate five 回答的是地點；Yes, I booked it 用 Yes 回答 Why 問句不合。

q: How many people will attend the event?
ex: How many people 問人數，Around two hundred 回答數量。At the city hall 回答的是地點；On Saturday night 回答的是時間。

q: Is this seat available?
ex: 問座位能不能坐，Yes, please sit down 回答可以。The train leaves at noon 說的是火車時間；No, I didn't see it 答非所問，see it 只是和 seat 發音相近。

q: How was your interview?
ex: How was 問面試的情況，It went very well 回答結果（很順利）。At two o'clock 回答的是時間；With Mr. Kim 回答的是和誰面試。

q: Is the elevator working now?
answer: Yes, they repaired it this morning.
distractors: I work on the third floor.
zh_answer: 可以，他們今天早上修好了。
ex: 問電梯現在能不能運作，Yes, they repaired it this morning 回答可以，並說明已經修好。I work on the third floor 的 work 是「上班」，沒有回答電梯的狀況；At the front desk 回答的是地點。

q: Where is the staff meeting today?
distractors: Yes, all the staff will attend.
zh_q: 今天的員工會議在哪裡開？
ex: Where 問會議地點，In room three oh two 回答地點（三○二室）。At two thirty 回答的是時間；Yes, all the staff will attend 用 Yes 回答 Where 問句不合，只是重複 staff。

q: Does the price include tax?
ex: 問價格有沒有含稅，Yes, tax is included 回答有。I'll take a taxi 的 taxi 只是和 tax 發音相近；At the cashier 回答的是地點。

q: Can you work this weekend?
zh_q: 你這個週末可以上班嗎？
ex: 問這個週末能不能上班，Sorry, I have other plans 表示不行。It works very well 的 work 是「運作」，主詞也不對；Yes, it was last weekend 說的是上週末，答非所問。

q: Would you like coffee or tea?
distractors: At the cafe on the corner.
ex: 用 or 連接的選擇問句要從兩個當中選一個，Coffee, please 選了咖啡。Yes, I would 沒有說要哪一個，選擇問句不能只用 Yes 回答；At the cafe on the corner 回答的是地點。

q: Where can I pay the parking fee?
answer: At the machine near the exit.
zh_q: 我可以在哪裡繳停車費？
ex: Where 問在哪裡繳停車費，At the machine near the exit 回答地點（出口旁的機器）。Five dollars an hour 回答的是多少錢；Until six o'clock 回答的是時間。

q: Is the manager in today?
answer: No, she's on a business trip.
ex: 問經理今天在不在，No, she's on a business trip 回答不在，出差去了。It's a good plan 和問題無關；Yes, I'm in sales 說的是自己的部門，不是經理。

q: How often does the bus come?
ex: How often 問頻率，Every fifteen minutes 回答頻率。Two dollars 回答的是車資；To the train station 回答的是目的地。

q: Would you like me to print the report?
ex: Would you like me to 是主動提議幫忙，Yes, two copies, please 表示接受並說要幾份。It's a weather report 只是重複 report；No, he reported it 的 report 是動詞「通報」，答非所問。

q: Did you finish the first draft?
answer: Not yet. I need one more day.
distractors: No, it's on the first floor.
ex: 問初稿寫完了沒，Not yet. I need one more day 回答還沒，還要一天。No, it's on the first floor 只是重複 first，說的是地點；At three thirty 回答的是時間。

q: When will the goods be delivered?
ex: When 問送貨時間，On Wednesday morning 回答時間。By truck 回答的是運送方式；To the warehouse 回答的是送到哪裡。

q: How long is the training period?
ex: How long 問時間長度，It's two weeks 回答多久。In the main building 回答的是地點；At ten thirty 回答的是幾點，不是多久。

q: How did you hear about our company?
zh_q: 您是怎麼知道我們公司的？
zh_answer: 我在網路上看到你們的廣告。
zh_distractors: 是的，我聽得到你的聲音。
ex: How did you hear about 問從哪裡得知，I saw your advertisement online 回答管道（網路廣告）。For three years 回答的是多久；Yes, I can hear you 用 Yes 回答 How 問句不合，而且 hear 在這裡是「聽得到」的意思。

q: Who can repair the copy machine?
answer: Mark can. He is good with machines.
zh_answer: 馬克會，他對機器很在行。
ex: Who 問誰會修，Mark can 直接回答人。By Friday afternoon 回答的是時間；Yes, I made ten copies 用 Yes 回答 Who 問句不合，只是重複 copy 這個字。

q: What is the minimum order?
ex: What is the minimum order 問最少要訂多少，Ten items 回答數量。By Friday 回答的是期限；Yes, I ordered it 用 Yes 回答 What 問句不合。

q: Who is the new cashier?
ex: Who 問人，Her name is Amy 回答是誰。Since last Monday 回答的是時間；Yes, I paid in cash 用 Yes 回答 Who 問句不合，cash 只是和 cashier 發音相近。

q: When does the flight depart?
ex: When 問班機起飛時間，At seven fifteen tonight 回答時間。From gate twelve 回答的是地點（登機門）；Yes, I have my ticket 用 Yes 回答 When 問句不合。

q: What's the subject of the email?
zh_q: 那封電子郵件的主旨是什麼？
ex: What's the subject 問郵件主旨，It's about next year's budget 說出內容（明年的預算）。I sent it this morning 回答的是何時寄的；To all the staff 回答的是寄給誰。

q: Why did you call the supplier?
zh_q: 你為什麼打電話給供應商？
ex: Why 問原因，To check on our order 用 To 加動詞說明目的。About ten minutes ago 回答的是時間；Yes, I called him 用 Yes 回答 Why 問句不合。

q: When can you start the new job?
zh_q: 你什麼時候可以開始新工作？
ex: When 問何時可以開始上班，Next Monday 回答時間。At the downtown office 回答的是地點；Yes, I applied online 用 Yes 回答 When 問句不合。

q: How do I get to the terminal?
ex: How do I get to 問交通方式，Take the airport bus 回答怎麼去。About twenty minutes 回答的是要多久；Yes, I got it 用 Yes 回答 How 問句不合，只是重複 get。

q: Who should I contact about the refund?
zh_q: 退款的事我應該聯絡誰？
ex: Who 問退款該找誰，Please call customer service 回答對象（客服部門）。Within seven days 回答的是期限；Thirty dollars 回答的是金額。

q: How can I contact the manager?
answer: You can send her an email.
zh_answer: 你可以寄電子郵件給她。
ex: How can I contact 問聯絡方式，You can send her an email 回答方法。For two hours 回答的是多久；Yes, she is the manager 用 Yes 回答 How 問句不合。

q: Why don't we take a short break?
answer: Good idea. I need some coffee.
zh_answer: 好主意，我需要喝點咖啡。
ex: Why don't we 是提議，不是問原因，Good idea 表示贊成。Because it was broken 把它當成問原因，而且 broken 只是和 break 相關；He took the bus 只是重複 take，沒有回應提議。

q: Can you show me how to use this device?
distractors: Yes, I used to live there.
zh_q: 你可以教我怎麼用這個裝置嗎？
ex: Can you show me 是請對方示範，Sure, just press this button 答應並說明用法。The show starts at eight 的 show 是「表演」；Yes, I used to live there 的 used to 是「以前曾經」，都答非所問。

q: Can I pay by credit card?
ex: 問能不能用信用卡付款，Sorry, we only take cash 表示不行，只收現金。On the third floor 回答的是地點；Yes, I paid him yesterday 說的是昨天付錢給別人，和問題無關。

q: When does the post office open?
ex: When 問開門時間，At nine every morning 回答時間。On Main Street 回答的是地點；Yes, it's open 用 Yes 回答 When 問句不合，也沒有說幾點開。

q: Where should I put this label?
answer: On the front of the box.
zh_q: 這張標籤我該貼在哪裡？
ex: Where 問標籤要貼在哪裡，On the front of the box 回答位置（箱子正面）。Mr. Lee did it 回答的是「誰」；Yes, it's a new label 用 Yes 回答 Where 問句不合，只是重複 label 這個字。

q: Can you send me the price list?
answer: Of course, I'll email it now.
zh_q: 你可以把價目表寄給我嗎？
zh_answer: 當然，我現在就用電子郵件寄。
ex: Can you 是請求，Of course, I'll email it now 答應並說明馬上寄。It's too expensive 只是由 price 聯想到貴；At the post office 回答的是地點，沒有回應請求。

q: Who is the leader of this project?
zh_q: 這個專案的負責人是誰？
ex: Who 問負責人是誰，Ms. Chen is 回答人。It's due next month 回答的是期限；Yes, it's a big project 用 Yes 回答 Who 問句不合，只是重複 project。

q: I can't find my receipt.
ex: 對方說找不到收據，Did you check your bag 建議他找找包包，是合理的回應。It's twenty dollars 說的是價錢；Yes, I received it 的 received 只是和 receipt 相關，和找不到收據無關。

q: Could you book a table for tonight?
zh_q: 你可以訂今晚的位子嗎？
ex: Could you book 是請對方訂位，Sure, for how many people 先答應，再問人數。I read that book 的 book 是「書」，不是「預訂」；It's on the table 只是重複 table，沒有回應請求。

q: Do I need to fill out this form?
answer: Yes, and please sign at the bottom.
ex: 問需不需要填表，Yes, and please sign at the bottom 回答要，還要簽名。The glass is full 的 full 只是和 fill 相近；No, I feel fine 的 feel 和 fill 發音相近，但答非所問。

q: Where does the tour start?
ex: Where 問導覽的出發地點，In the hotel lobby 回答地點（飯店大廳）。It takes about two hours 回答的是要花多久；Twenty dollars per person 回答的是費用。

q: Who will attend the meeting?
ex: Who 問誰會出席，Everyone in the sales department 回答人（業務部所有人）。In the conference room 回答的是地點；It starts at three 回答的是時間。

q: What software do you use at work?
ex: What software 問用哪種軟體，Mostly a spreadsheet program 回答軟體種類。Since last year 回答的是時間；On the second floor 回答的是地點。

q: Is there a bank near here?
answer: Yes, there's one across the street.
distractors: No, he is not here today.
ex: 問附近有沒有銀行，Yes, there's one across the street 回答有，並說出位置。By bank transfer 回答的是付款方式；No, he is not here today 說的是某個人不在，和問題無關。

q: Could you call me back later?
zh_q: 你可以晚一點回電給我嗎？
ex: Could you call me back 是請對方回電，Sure, what time is good 答應並問時間。It's in the back room 只是重複 back；Yes, it was late 只是用 late 混淆 later，沒有回應請求。

q: When is your appointment with the client?
distractors: Yes, he is a new client.
zh_q: 你和客戶約什麼時候見面？
ex: When 問約見的時間，Thursday at ten o'clock 回答時間。At his office downtown 回答的是地點；Yes, he is a new client 用 Yes 回答 When 問句不合，只是重複 client。

q: This is my first day here.
zh_q: 今天是我第一天來這裡上班。
ex: 對方說今天第一天來，Welcome. I'll show you around 表示歡迎並要帶他認識環境。Yes, it was yesterday 說的是昨天，時間不對；On the first floor 只是重複 first，說的是地點。

q: Have you met the new employee?
zh_answer: 見過了，我們今天早上見面的。
ex: 問有沒有見過新員工，Yes, we met this morning 回答見過了。The meeting is at two 只是用 meeting 混淆 met；No, I'm not new here 說的是自己，沒有回答問題。

q: Where can I find the user manual?
zh_q: 我可以在哪裡找到使用手冊？
ex: Where 問手冊放在哪裡，It's in the top drawer 回答位置（最上層抽屜）。By tomorrow morning 回答的是期限；Yes, I read it yesterday 用 Yes 回答 Where 問句不合。

q: Where is the receptionist?
ex: Where 問接待員在哪裡，She's at the front desk 回答地點（櫃台）。She started last week 說的是她什麼時候開始上班；Yes, she is very friendly 用 Yes 回答 Where 問句不合。

q: How many copies do you need?
ex: How many copies 問數量，Twenty, please 回答數量。By noon 回答的是期限；Yes, I made a copy 用 Yes 回答 How many 問句不合，只是重複 copy。

q: Where can I rent a car?
answer: There's a shop behind the station.
ex: Where 問可以在哪裡租車，There's a shop behind the station 說出地點（車站後面的店）。Forty dollars a day 回答的是租金；Yes, I drove here 用 Yes 回答 Where 問句不合。

q: Where is your company located?
ex: Where 問公司的位置，In the business district 回答地點（商業區）。For about ten years 回答的是多久；We sell office equipment 說的是公司賣什麼，沒有回答地點。

q: Why do you want to return this item?
zh_q: 您為什麼想退這件商品？
ex: Why 問退貨原因，Because it's the wrong size 回答原因。Last Saturday 回答的是時間；At the service counter 回答的是地點。

q: The store closes at nine, doesn't it?
ex: 附加問句是在確認關門時間，Yes, every day 表示沒錯，每天都九點關。It's very close 的 close 是「近」，不是「關門」；Nine dollars 只是重複 nine，說的是價錢。

q: When will the repair be finished?
ex: When 問修理何時完成，By tomorrow afternoon 回答時間（明天下午前）。About fifty dollars 回答的是費用；Yes, it was broken 用 Yes 回答 When 問句不合。

q: When did you upload the file?
zh_q: 你什麼時候上傳檔案的？
ex: When 問上傳的時間，About an hour ago 回答時間（約一小時前）。To the company website 回答的是上傳到哪裡；No, I'll call him 用 No 回答 When 問句不合。

q: What time does the clinic close?
ex: What time 問時間，At six in the evening 回答時間。On Lake Street 回答的是地點；Yes, it's close to here 用 Yes 回答不合，而且這裡的 close 是「近」，不是「關門」。

q: Should I call the client or send an email?
distractors: Yes, he is a good client.
zh_q: 我應該打電話給客戶，還是寄電子郵件？
ex: 選擇問句問打電話或寄郵件，Send an email, please 選了寄郵件。Yes, he is a good client 沒有選任何一個，選擇問句不能只用 Yes 回答；Near the elevator 回答的是地點。

q: What is your occupation?
ex: What is your occupation 問職業，I'm an engineer 回答職業。I live downtown 說的是住哪裡；At eight every morning 回答的是時間。

q: Isn't the warehouse closed on Sundays?
zh_q: 倉庫星期日不是不開嗎？
ex: 否定問句 Isn't the warehouse closed 是在確認「星期日沒開吧？」。回答方式和一般問句一樣：沒有關就說 No。No, it's open until three 回答有開，開到三點。It's close to the station 的 close 是「近」；Yes, I closed the door 說的是關門這個動作，都沒有回答倉庫有沒有開。

q: How many employees work here?
ex: How many 問人數，About fifty 回答數量。From nine to five 回答的是上班時間；Near the station 回答的是地點。

q: Where is the nearest pharmacy?
ex: Where 問地點，It's next to the bank 說出藥局的位置（銀行旁邊）。At nine in the morning 回答的是時間；Yes, I bought some medicine 用 Yes 回答 Where 問句不合，只是用 medicine 讓人聯想到 pharmacy。

q: Is the conference room available at two?
zh_answer: 不行，已經被預訂到三點。
ex: 問會議室兩點有沒有空，No, it's booked until three 回答沒有，被訂到三點。Two tickets, please 只是重複 two；It's a big room 只是描述房間，沒有回答能不能用。

q: What kind of beverage would you like?
distractors: At the table by the window.
ex: What kind of beverage 問要哪一種飲料，Just water, please 回答飲料。Yes, it was great 用 Yes 回答 What 問句不合，也沒有說要喝什麼；At the table by the window 回答的是位置。

q: Where did you buy that printer?
answer: At a store on Park Street.
zh_q: 那台印表機你是在哪裡買的？
ex: Where 問在哪裡買的，At a store on Park Street 回答地點。Last Friday 回答的是時間；It prints very fast 只是描述印表機，沒有回答在哪裡買。

q: When is the company's anniversary party?
zh_q: 公司的週年派對是什麼時候？
ex: When 問派對日期，On June tenth 回答日期（六月十日）。At the Harbor Hotel 回答的是地點；For twenty years 回答的是多久，沒有說哪一天。

q: How long have you worked for this company?
zh_q: 你在這家公司工作多久了？
ex: How long 問多久，For almost five years 回答時間長度。By bus 回答的是交通方式；In the design department 回答的是部門，不是多久。

q: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
ex: Please turn off the lights 是請對方關燈，Okay, I will 表示答應。Turn left at the corner 的 turn 是「轉彎」；It's very light 的 light 是「輕」，都和關燈無關。

q: What is the purpose of your trip?
zh_q: 您這趟旅行的目的是什麼？
ex: What is the purpose 問目的，I'm here on business 回答目的（出差）。For five days 回答的是停留多久；By plane 回答的是交通方式。

q: How much is the discount?
ex: How much is the discount 問折扣多少，Twenty percent off 回答折扣（減百分之二十，也就是打八折）。Until Sunday 回答的是期限；Yes, it's on sale 用 Yes 回答 How much 問句不合。

q: What was the result of the survey?
ex: What was the result 問結果，Most customers were happy 說出調查結果。It took ten minutes 回答的是花多久；By email 回答的是方式。

q: You've met Mr. Kim, haven't you?
zh_answer: 見過，在上星期的會議上。
ex: 附加問句是在確認有沒有見過金先生，Yes, at last week's meeting 回答見過，並說在哪裡見的。The meeting room is upstairs 說的是會議室位置；It's nice to meet you 是初次見面的招呼語，不是在回答問題。

q: Do you need a receipt?
ex: 問需不需要收據，Yes, please 回答需要。It's twelve dollars 回答的是價錢；I received it on Monday 的 received 只是和 receipt 相關，沒有回答需不需要。

q: How far is the hotel from here?
ex: How far 問距離，About ten minutes on foot 回答距離（走路約十分鐘）。It has one hundred rooms 說的是房間數；Eighty dollars a night 回答的是房價。

q: How much does this item cost?
ex: How much 問價錢，It's fifteen dollars 回答金額。On the top shelf 回答的是位置；Yes, we have three 用 Yes 回答 How much 問句不合。

q: Which department do you work in?
ex: Which department 問哪個部門，I'm in sales 回答部門（業務部）。For two years 回答的是多久；Yes, it's a department store 用 Yes 回答 Which 問句不合，department store 是「百貨公司」。

q: Did you get my email?
answer: Yes, I read it this morning.
distractors: No, she is in her office.
zh_q: 你有收到我的電子郵件嗎？
ex: 問有沒有收到郵件，Yes, I read it this morning 回答有，而且已經看過。By express mail 回答的是寄送方式；No, she is in her office 的主詞 she 和問題無關。

q: Has the package arrived yet?
answer: No, it will come this afternoon.
ex: 問包裹到了沒，No, it will come this afternoon 回答還沒，下午才到。Five dollars for shipping 回答的是運費；Yes, I arrived at eight 說的是自己幾點到，不是包裹。

q: When is the payment due?
answer: At the end of this month.
ex: When 問付款期限，At the end of this month 回答時間（月底）。Two hundred dollars 回答的是金額；By credit card 回答的是付款方式。

q: What did the client request?
answer: A sample of the new product.
ex: What 問客戶要求的東西，A sample of the new product 回答東西（新產品的樣品）。On Tuesday 回答的是時間；Yes, he is our client 用 Yes 回答 What 問句不合。

q: Are the samples ready?
answer: Yes, they are on your desk.
ex: 問樣品好了沒，Yes, they are on your desk 回答好了，並說放在哪裡。Yes, it is simple 的 simple 只是和 sample 發音相近，答非所問；Two dollars each 回答的是價錢。

q: Why is the lobby closed today?
ex: Why 問原因，Because workers are painting it 回答原因（工人在粉刷）。Until five o'clock 回答的是時間；Behind the hotel 回答的是地點。
